description: This file provides a fake implementation of a local data store for testing purposes, specifically storing Task objects in-memory to facilitate testing without using Android SharedPreferences. It defines classes for testing the data storage interface, including methods to load and save tasks.

classes.name: LocalDataStoreFakeForTests
classes.description: A test-only fake of LocalDataStore that stores tasks in-memory for testing.

classes.name: LocalDataStoreTestFacade
classes.description: A facade exposing only the methods used in production LocalDataStore for testing purposes.

methods.name: loadTasks
methods.description: Loads tasks from in-memory storage; overridden to return current stored tasks.

methods.name: saveTasks
methods.description: Saves tasks to in-memory storage; overridden to update the storage list.
